metadata.title: Positive sectional curvature on exotic spheres in infinitely many dimensions
metadata.abstract: We show that there exist exotic spheres with metrics of strictly positive sectional curvature in infinitely many dimensions: in every dimension $n\equiv3\pmod4$ with $n\geq11$ and $n\not\equiv255\pmod{256}$. Previously, every known closed simply connected manifold of positive sectional curvature in a dimension above $24$ was diffeomorphic to a compact rank-one symmetric space. The spheres we consider are certain homotopy spheres arising as quotients of special $S^3$-$S^3$ bundles introduced by Sperança. These homotopy spheres are determined by an orthogonal representation $\rho$ of $S^3$ and an $S^3$-conjugation-equivariant map $\beta$, and are denoted $\Sigma_{\rho,\beta}$. By recent constructions, such spheres admit Riemannian metrics of strictly positive sectional curvature. In this paper we consider the spheres $\Sigma_{\rho_b,\beta}$ of dimension $4b+3$, $b\geq2$, where $\rho_b$ is the representation of $S^3$ on $\mathbb{R}^3\oplus\mathbb{H}^b$ by left multiplication on the second summand. For these spheres, we show that the Eells-Kuiper invariant is the product of an integer $k(\beta)$ depending only on $\beta$ and a rational number $r_b$ given by one coefficient of a power series built from the $\hat A$- and $L$-genera. We then show that, for every $b\geq2$ with $b\not\equiv63\pmod{64}$, there is a map $\beta$ for which the Eells-Kuiper invariant does not vanish, and thus the corresponding sphere is exotic. A computer calculation also gives the dimensions $n\equiv255\pmod{256}$ below $2^{16}$.

analysis.breakthrough: 在 n≡3 mod 4、n≥11 且 n≢255 mod 256 的维数中，通过非零不变量证明候选球面具有异域光滑结构。
analysis.limitations: 无限维主结论的拓扑判别不依赖计算；被排除同余类在 n<2¹⁶ 的结论依赖作者精确程序，本站未独立运行。外部正曲率构造与粘合定理是关键输入，Lean 项目仍把文献结果作为显式假设；未逐步验证这些输入或全部 2-adic 论证。 已补读 Theorem A、Corollary B、Theorem C 及 §2.2 外部曲率输入，不是对整篇证明的独立核验。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露 ChatGPT Astra 与 Claude Opus 5.5 协助数学探索、草稿、计算程序、文献检索和内部审阅；后文说明作者独立核验并负责。提及 Lean 形式化和以文献结论为显式假设，不据此声称外部曲率输入已全部形式化证明。
